pages.text: The $(item)Sketching Pencil$() and $(item)Crayon$() place client-side imaginary voxels only you (or glasses wearers) can see. Pencil shapes are grey; crayons carry dye colour.

Scroll or sneak to change placement mode: block, slab, stairs, panel, and more. Imaginary blocks have no collision until made real by other mods or admin tools. $(item)Imagination Glasses$() let friends see your sketches.
Upgrade a pencil with dye for coloured crayons.
